findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator allows client-controlled negative offsets
findings.body: In src/sentry/api/paginator.py OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result explicitly uses cursor.offset directly when enable_advanced_features and offset < 0: start_offset = cursor.offset. Cursor offset/value/is_prev come from the client-supplied cursor string (Cursor.from_string), so an attacker can send e.g. value:offset:is_prev with a negative offset. Django QuerySets do not support negative indexing/slicing (raises AssertionError) and Python sequences wrap around, so this breaks the offset>=0 invariant enforced by OffsetPaginator, ChainPaginator and SequencePaginator, causing 500s / DoS or returning rows from the end of the set outside the intended window. Fix: reject negative offsets with BadPaginationError like other paginators.

findings.title: BasePaginator now passes through negative offsets for prev cursors
findings.body: In src/sentry/api/paginator.py BasePaginator.get_result was changed from queryset[offset:stop] to start_offset = max(0, offset) if not cursor.is_prev else offset. For is_prev cursors the raw client-controlled offset is now used without clamping. A crafted cursor with is_prev=1 and negative offset therefore reaches queryset[start_offset:stop] with a negative start. This violates the pagination contract, triggers Django's negative-slicing AssertionError (500) or unintended wrap-around semantics, and is reachable on all endpoints using BasePaginator/DateTimePaginator without any advanced flag. Fix: clamp/validate to offset>=0 for both directions.

findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator incompatible with datetime ordering
findings.body: In src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py the optimized path uses OptimizedCursorPaginator with order_by="-datetime". Its get_item_key/value_from_cursor in src/sentry/api/paginator.py do int(math.floor(value)) / return cursor.value, i.e. the numeric Paginator logic, not the DateTimePaginator logic that converts datetime to/from timestamp with multiplier and timezone. Passing a datetime object to math.floor/math.ceil raises TypeError, and integer cursor values will not filter datetimes correctly in build_queryset. The endpoint will 500 or paginate incorrectly when optimized_pagination=true. Fix: do not use this paginator for datetime keys or implement datetime conversion.
